Create_Variables.title: Create Variables

ForEach_Raw_Alert.description: Iterates through each alert and processes them individually (parallel execution enabled)

Parse_Observables.title: Parse Observables
Parse_Observables.description: Parses observables (IPs, domains, URLs) from alert data into structured format

Get_Alert_UID.title: Get Alert UID
Get_Alert_UID.description: Extracts unique alert identifier for deduplication

alert_uid.title: Alert UID
alert_uid.description: Alert UID for deduplication purposes.  String.  Mandatory.

Deduplicate_Alert.title: Deduplicate Alert
Deduplicate_Alert.description: Checks if alert already exists in SIG to prevent duplicate processing

condition_auoj2.title: If New Alert
condition_auoj2.description: Processes only alerts that haven't been ingested previously

Parse_Alert_Fields.title: Parse Alert Fields
Parse_Alert_Fields.description: Extracts and transforms alert fields into TEDS-compliant format

alert_categories.title: Alert Categories
alert_categories.description: Categories this alert falls into.  String Array.  Optional.

alert_created_timestamp.title: Alert Created Timestamp
alert_created_timestamp.description: Time when the alert was created in the tool.  ISO8601 String.  Optional.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the alert.  String.  Optional.

alert_end_timestamp.title: Alert End Timestamp
alert_end_timestamp.description: Time when the alert ended in the tool.  ISO8601 String.  Optional.

alert_ingested_timestamp.title: Alert Ingested Timestamp
alert_ingested_timestamp.description: The current time. ISO8601 String. Recommended.

alert_impacted_hostnames.title: Alert Impacted Hostnames
alert_impacted_hostnames.description: Internal hostnames impacted by this alert.  String Array. Optional.

alert_impacted_ip_addresses.title: Alert Impacted IP Addresses
alert_impacted_ip_addresses.description: Internal IP addresses impacted by this alert.  String Array. Optional.

alert_impacted_usernames.title: Alert Impacted Usernames
alert_impacted_usernames.description: Internal usernames impacted by this alert.  String Array. Optional.

mitre_attck_tactics_and_techniques.title: MITRE ATT&CK Tactics and Techniques
mitre_attck_tactics_and_techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK Tactics and Techniques.  Object Array.  Optional. See https://docs.swimlane.com/teds-reference for formatting.

inputs.expression:
/* The organization whose infrastructure this event occurred on.  String.  Mandatory. */
"Swimlane"

alert_originating_files.title: Alert Originating Files
alert_originating_files.description: Filenames and paths associated with this alert.  String Array.  Optional.

alert_permalink.title: Alert Permalink
alert_permalink.description: Permalink to the alert in the originating tool.  String. Optional.

alert_provider.title: Alert Provider
alert_provider.description: Name of the originating tool.  String.  Recommended.

alert_risk_score.title: Alert Risk Score
alert_risk_score.description: Risk score of the alert, defined by the originating tool.  Number. Optional.

alert_rules.title: Alert Rules
alert_rules.description: Alert rules related to this alert, from the originating tool.  Object Array.  Recommended. See https://docs.swimlane.com/teds-reference for formatting.

alert_severity.title: Alert Severity
alert_severity.description: Alert Severity - Critical, High, Medium, Low, None. String. Optional.

alert_start_timestamp.title: Alert Start Timestamp
alert_start_timestamp.description: Time when the alert began.  ISO8601 String.  Optional.

Parallel.description: Executes enrichment tasks simultaneously for performance

Enrich_Observables.description: Queries threat intelligence sources for observable reputation and context
